Mezhyriv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the older of Mezhyriv's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion record to the town's separately documented New cemetery. Sources disagree on its fate: the Commission on the Preservation of Jewish Heritage dates its demolition to the 1930s, yet local residents recall tombstones still standing there into the 1960s — a discrepancy flagged here rather than resolved. One local resident recalled helping move some of the tombstones as a child, though he does not know where they ended up. Mezhyriv's Jewish community, present from the town's founding in the early 16th century, once ran one of the region's early Jewish printing houses, established in 1787, and reached nearly 60 percent of the town's population by 1897.
